title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Plan International Ireland SQRIBE programme is located across seven locations across Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Burkina Faso, Mali, Central African Republic, and Cameroon. The intended outcome is that Vulnerable and Marginalised Children Realise their Rights to Access and Benefit from a Safe, Quality, Resilient and Inclusion-Based Education (SQRIBE). The objective of the grant is to meet [urgent] education and protection needs for children. The key activities include financial and technical support to schools and vocational centres, community sensitisation and mobilisation in relation to child rights, in particular girls’ rights, and capacity building for education stakeholders. The programme is delivered in partnership with local partners.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome Climate Change: Learning spaces are increasingly resilient to the effects of climate change.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: A climate-specific objective under the SQRIBE programme was designed following the additional climate funding provided by Irish Aid. The project was assessed, and the climate component (a climate specific objective in each project site) was found to have climate change adaptation as the principal objective as the explicitly stated motivation for undertaking the objective, and as the fundamental driver. This component of the SQRIBE programme has climate change adaptation as the primary objective. Promoting the objective will therefore be stated in the Results Based Framework to be the principal reason for carrying out this component of the project. In other words, the climate-specific component of the SQRIBE project would not have been funded with the additional Irish Aid Climate Unit funding, but for that principal objective.
